_comment: Sample machine-checkable guardrail suite for regression-check.mjs. Copy to config/regression-suite.json and adapt to your workspace. Each entry turns a prose guardrail into an assertion. Run: node scripts/regression-check.mjs --spec config/regression-suite.json --root .

checks.description: Secrets file must never be committed
Session brief must exist for fast startup
Session brief stays a brief, not a log (<= 60 lines)
Public README carries no em-dash (AWDS v1.01)
Subagent ledger present so stalled work is visible
